name: Bamboo grove
desc: A duel, a pursuit, a conversation with no witnesses - vertical lines and very short sightlines.
tags: scenery, no humans, bamboo forest, dense vertical bamboo stalks, packed close, green filtered light, narrow stone path, dry bamboo leaves on ground, thin shafts of sunlight, bamboo leaves overhead
prose: a dense bamboo grove, tall green stalks packed close in vertical lines, a narrow stone path underfoot scattered with dry bamboo leaves and green-filtered light coming down through the canopy
note: The stalks must stay parallel and vertical - loosen the tags and the model bends them into jungle, or reduces them to a thin ornamental screen with a garden visible behind. Density is the load-bearing tag: packed close, dense, filling frame. Panda and Chinese garden associations pull it toward a tourist shot, so a plain stone path and fallen leaves keep it a working grove. Filed as room scale on purpose - the point is that you cannot see far, so do not pair it with a distant view.
